subject: POC scope & on-call / procurement path for Aurelia Health
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tina Park <tina@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC scope & on-call / procurement path for Aurelia Health

Hi Tina —

Great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a shared checklist for the POC (please flag anything I missed):

What we heard from your side
- Goal: reduce triage time for patient intake summaries and automate routine administrative replies while preserving PHI controls.
- Initial volume target: ~1k inference reqs/minute peak during internal load test; expected production scale later.
- Security: your security team requires SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, and a documented on-call escalation path.
- Procurement: target window ~4–8 weeks depending on contract redlines.

Proposed POC success criteria (minimum viable):
1) Performance: 90th percentile latency < 350ms with a realistic input mix (50–200 tokens typical).
2) Quality: pass rate >= 92% on your 120-item evaluation prompt set (we'll co-sign the prompt list).
3) Reliability: no more than 1 incident causing >5min downtime during a 72-hour soak.
4) Security & compliance: SOC2 evidence checklist reviewed, streaming logs to your SIEM (obfuscated PHI) and audit log export validated.
5) Integration: SDK-driven integration + end-to-end runbook executed by your infra/app teams.

Proposed ownership / RACI high-level (we will publish a formal RACI sheet in the runbook):
- Redwood (Responsible): serving runtime, model variant selection, quantization recommendations, runbook, and day-0 on-call primary during working hours.
- Aurelia App Team (Responsible): integration of SDK, UI/UX validation, prompt set curation, and local regression checks.
- Aurelia Security (Accountable): sign-off on SOC2 evidence, acceptance of audit logs approach.
- Procurement (Consulted): Priyom / Karthik will coordinate any commercial questions and procurement artifacts.
- Exec sponsors (Informed): weekly summary during the POC.

On-call / escalation proposal (short):
- Redwood provides 9am–5pm PT primary support M–F for the POC.
- For sev1 outside hours, Redwood provides an on-call handoff (paged rotation) and will escalate to Aurelia on-call contacts if the incident affects data integrity.
- We'll document exact SLOs and escalation contacts in the runbook.

Next steps (ask list):
1) Tina — confirm the success criteria above or propose edits by EOD Wed.
2) Aurelia security (cc) — can you confirm the SOC2 artifacts you need (type/retention)?
3) Priyom / Karthik — can you prepare a procurement checklist and draft MSA redlines for initial review?
4) Schedule: propose kickoff lab 2026-08-10 10:00 AM PT for infra smoke test.

Attachments: "Aurelia-POC-MAP.xlsx" (mutual action plan draft), "Redwood-POC-Runbook-v1.docx" (initial runbook stub).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 30m to walk through this.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee

On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 4:05 PM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a shared checklist for the POC...

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful and aligns with our internal read. A few clarifying items from our side:
- Security: we'll need a short inventory of the SOC2 artifact types (report copy, control narratives, AICPA contact) and a sample audit log export format. If you can drop the SOC2 bundle to the Drive link that helps speed our review.
- On-call: Aurelia will own the application-level on-call (pager for downstream app errors). For platform/runtime sev1s we need Redwood to provide: 15-minute acknowledgment during business hours and documented runbook for SLO violation steps.
- Procurement: 6-week target is realistic for our legal + vendor intake. We will try to accelerate if we can avoid custom IP clauses.

Samir (cc) — I want you to be the infra contact for the smoke test. He will coordinate our side for network allowlists and private peering if needed. Samir — can you confirm the capability to accept a dedicated instance or whether we need VPC peering?

I like the August 10 kickoff — let's tentatively hold that time. I'll confirm after Samir checks networking.

Best,
Tina Park
Director, Digital Transformation | Aurelia Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope & on-call / procurement path for Aurelia Health

Soojin / team — quick note from an infra/SE perspective (drafting the RACI details referenced above):

Proposed detailed responsibilities for the POC (text table):
- Redwood (Responsible): runtime hosting, model configuration, KV/prefix cache recommendations, token-cost estimates, runbook & smoke test checklist, primary support M–F 9–5 PT. Provide SOC2 evidence package (summary + auditor contact) and an example audit-log export (redacted).
- Aurelia App Team (Responsible): integrate Redwood SDK, provide prompt set and ground-truth labels, run acceptance tests against the evaluation set, validate UX. Samir is the infra point for network/firewall.
- Aurelia Security (Accountable): accept SOC2 docs and sign off on log retention and obfuscation approach.
- Procurement (Consulted): Priyom (commercial lead) + Karthik (legal intake) to own MSA redlines and PO flow.
- Execs (Informed): weekly 15m sync for status during POC.

On-call specifics (proposal for POC):
1) Redwood acknowledges Sev1 pages within 15 minutes M–F 9–5 PT.
2) If issue persists beyond 30 minutes and impacts the soak, Redwood escalates to Aurelia primary on-call.
3) For the POC we can provide a small reserved dedicated pool (short-term) to ensure stable latency; procurement permitting, this can be converted to reserved capacity if you sign for Dedicated.

Questions for Priyom/Karthik: can we preload a typical procurement checklist (invoice flow, PO template, PO contact, any required W-9/EU tax docs) into the Drive folder so Aurelia has everything in one place?

I'll attach a short RACI snippet to the runbook and push updated artifacts to the Drive link after this thread.

—Ben
